# Habit streak calendar

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/habit-tracker/

Track several habits on a monthly calendar, inspect current and longest recorded streaks and export a printable progress sheet.

## How to use it

1. Choose or enter the content for this tool.
2. Start the action with the settings you want.
3. Review the result before copying, sharing or continuing.

## Example

Track reading and walking for one month, then print your recorded completion grid.

## Limits and checks

Entries are self-reported. Optional local storage is not a permanent backup, and this tracker makes no health or behavior-change diagnosis.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
